name: Degenerate Creature (CR –1)
body:
Degenerate creatures are weaker than their ordinary cousins.

Quick Rules: Creature suffers –2 on all rolls (including damage rolls) and to special ability DCs; –2 to AC and CMD; –2 hp/HD.

Rebuild Rules: Reduce all ability scores by 4 (minimum 1).
